resources.string: Deadlines, exams and your remaining study estimates.
Sign in to a UIT service to inspect its saved workload.
Based on saved sources. This is not a guarantee of availability or a complete study schedule.
Blank means unknown. Zero remaining minutes never marks an LMS submission complete.
No upcoming items in saved data
Missing cached records do not mean coursework is complete.
Overdue items stay separate and are not silently moved to a new deadline or included in future demand.
Kept on this device. A missing source is not treated as deleted or submitted.
Use Find free time and save blocks on this device, then reopen Workload preview. Unsaved drafts are excluded.
Demand sums entered remaining minutes up to this cutoff. Capacity merges busy intervals, subtracts buffers and respects weekday windows, daily budgets and minimum session length.
Having enough time at each cutoff does not guarantee these sessions fit together. This preview does not assign study sessions.
Local planning data could not be read. Existing data was retained; reload or choose another account.
Changes could not be saved. Your draft remains open.
Check the entered whole-minute values and configuration limits.
This saved source could not be analyzed. Reload local data or refresh the source from the workspace.
Within the entered budget at this cutoff
Choose a teaching-calendar account in Configure budget. No calendar was silently assigned.
A selected source is unavailable or has no saved snapshot. Missing records are not assumed empty.
A selected account has unreadable local planning data. Its saved records were retained.
A selected source exceeds your freshness threshold or has a future saved timestamp.
Some busy events have no end time. Their duration is not invented; conservative and optimistic scenarios differ.
Linked records disagree about timing, ownership reference or submission state. Inspect the source before relying on this projection.
Saved personal blocks could not be read. They were not silently assumed absent.
The displayed budget is an editable default. Review and save it in Configure budget.
Some assignments have no usable due date and are outside the dated analysis.
Enter remaining study minutes, not total hours already spent. Leave blank for unknown; clear both fields to remove an estimate. This does not submit work.
Optional personal assumption for an exam with no reported end. It never changes the official exam record.
Configuration belongs to this planning account. All times use GMT+07. Defaults are not confirmed until you save.
Choose one DAA or Portal source to avoid counting the same exam from two services. Its exam estimates stay with that source account.
Zero is a day off. A nonzero budget must fit the minimum session size. Today means the remaining planning window; past study time is not inferred.
Include non-deadline calendar events as busy time
Check every weekday: valid same-day HH:mm windows, budgets of zero or minimum-session to 720 minutes, and the displayed policy limits.
The last workspace refresh reported an error. Cached sections may be partial; inspect the original source.
